title: You share 60% of your DNA with a banana
voiceover: You share about 60 percent of your DNA with a banana. Not 6 — sixty. Most of that overlap is the boring stuff. The basic genetic code every living thing on Earth needs. Processing energy. Dividing cells. Repairing damage. It's the same instructions, just reshuffled. You also share 50 percent of your DNA with a cabbage, 70 percent with a slug, and 99 percent with a chimpanzee. Life isn't a chain of separate species. It's a remix of the same source code. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
emphasis: remix of the same source code
